title: AgentResult
description: What a worker submits at the end of an attempt (reference architecture v1.2 section 29). A proposal, never an outcome: the kernel runs schema, freshness/policy and verifier checks before the Task is accepted.

status.description: needs_input: the agent asked participant questions and the Task waits; failed must carry failure_category.

output_artifact_refs.description: Draft versions saved during the attempt that this result proposes as the Task's output.

input_versions.description: The dependency_versions the agent actually used; compared with current state on submit.

proposed_actions.description: Always empty in the POC: effects are requested during the attempt through request_action.

summary.description: One plain sentence for the timeline and the buyer, e.g. 'Ranked 5 suppliers from ERP history.'

reply_blocks.description: Completed agent message blocks. Required when an assist attempt submits status completed.
